sections.Profile:
"Lady Luck," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1954, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features a gambling theme, with the backglass depicting a casino scene. The playfield includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, and three kick-out holes.
